Kael leaned down, staring out at the horizon where the beam swept slow, and smiled, already reaching for his own pen to write a reply.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还笼在薄而凉的暗蓝色里，临街的店铺都落着卷帘门，只有二十四小时便利店的玻璃门漏出暖黄的光，门口摆着刚拆封的鲜牛奶纸箱。环卫工拿着扫帚扫过落了半街的梧桐叶，车轮碾过路面的轻响在空荡的街上飘得很远。偶尔有晚归的出租车驶过，车灯拖出一道长而软的光带，天边已经浮起极淡的鱼肚白，连风都放轻了脚步，怕吵醒还在做甜梦的人。", "w03": "- Recursion is when you work your way through a stack of nested matching boxes, where every box you open holds a smaller version of the same box inside it.\n- You only open the current box in front of you, then repeat the exact same action on the smaller box inside until you reach the tiniest box that holds a small sticker surprise.\n- Once you find that sticker, you tuck it safely away, close each box one by one as you climb back out, until you're standing with the very first big box you started with."}
